import numpy as np
def equation(t, A, params):
    p = params
    k = p[0] + p[1]/t + p[2]*t
    K = np.abs(p[3] + p[4]*t + p[5]/t)
    n = p[6]
    m = p[7]
    return -k * np.abs(A)**n / (1 + K*np.abs(A))**m
